name: High Sorcerer Andromath

narrative.details:
High Sorcerer Andromath wishes to speak with you, adventurer.  He is at the top of the wizard's sanctum, in the mage's district of Stormwind.

It would be wise to speak with him, for Andromath is one of the most powerful mages not locked away in Dalaran.  Council with him is high council indeed.
narrative.offerRewardText: Greetings, adventurer. I am pleased to see you, and hope you have time to listen to an old man's words...

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 26 to 28, 7,050 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic to High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind.
